title: analytics: the draft preview answers a dataset query naming a measure the dataset does not declare as a row count, where the live query refuses it INVALID_FIELD
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyJ2FnmRRSXEUtT6G1

Found and measured by the #28127 card thread (PR #28169, os-dev report 6526002302), outside that card's rule. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What happens (measured)

At PR #28169's head `925343a7` (same on `origin/main` `062a2323`), over a real SQLite engine, `queryDataset` on a dataset declaring `total` (sum) and `deals` (count), selecting `{ dimensions: ['region'], measures: ['nope'] }`:

| Face | Answer |
|:---|:---|
| native strategy | refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400: "Measure 'nope' on cube … aggregates field 'nope', which object … does not have. Valid measures: total, deals. …" |
| ObjectQL strategy | same refusal |
| draft preview (`previewDrafts: true`, pending seed draft) | served `[{ region: 'amer', nope: 2 }, { region: 'emea', nope: 1 }]`: a row count per group under the misspelled name |

Before #28169 the same arm also turned a derived-of-derived operand into a row count on the preview (`twice_per_deal` read 1 where the answer is 150), which is how it was found.

## Where (read)

`evaluateAnalyticsQueryOverRows` (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/preview-evaluator.ts`, step 3 "Aggregate each measure per group", ~L875): `aggregate(g.rows, String(metric?.type ?? 'count'), String(metric?.sql ?? '*'))`. A measure `cube.measures` does not declare falls through to `count(*)` instead of being refused the way the published cube door refuses it.

## Expected

The draft preview refuses a measure the dataset does not declare with the live faces' `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 (member named), so a typo in a draft widget shows the same refusal it will meet once published instead of a plausible count. Dedupe words: preview evaluator unknown measure, undeclared measure count star, draft preview INVALID_FIELD parity.
